verdict.rationale: Angular does provide components that bundle template and logic. Community reports confirm components are encapsulated and that templates can live as strings inside the component. However, the template syntax (*ngFor, [title]) is described as non-standard HTML that existing tooling can't handle, and string templates lose editor support. That undercuts the 'HTML/CSS/JS I already know' part of the story. Missing for 10: first-party docs showing markup, styles and logic co-located in one component; evidence of CSS scoping within components; evidence the template syntax is plain HTML/JS rather than framework-specific.
